value.rationale: This is a natural full-dimensional invariant regime of the exact source opinion dynamics rather than an arbitrarily sliced numerical example. It resolves a meaningful distinction between asymptotic opinion convergence and eventual receptive-graph freezing, quantitatively predicts quadratic-in-population relaxation, and provides fully connected initial-community examples with persistent paths. These strengthen qualitative width bounds and are mathematically interpretable for opinion fragmentation, not merely textbook corollaries.
